The '''Emperor of Vespera''' was the supreme monarch of the [[Vesperan Empire]] from its proclamation in 1710 until its collapse in 1949. The office combined political command, military authority, dynastic legitimacy, and religious status under the [[Imperial Cult]].

== Authority ==

The emperor ruled as an absolute imperial monarch, assisted by the [[Imperial Council]], court ministries, military commanders, aristocratic networks, and religious officials. The council did not function as a constitutional limit on the emperor; it helped the imperial center govern a large and diverse empire.

== Religious Status ==

Under the Imperial Cult, the emperor was presented as the earthly representative of divine order. The [[Imperial Coronation Ceremony]] publicly established this status and required oaths of loyalty from the elite institutions of the empire.

== Collapse ==

The office ceased to function as a recognized state authority when the Vesperan Empire collapsed at the end of the [[Avant Great War]] in 1949. Loyalist commanders and rogue units continued resistance during the [[Continuation War]], but they no longer represented a functioning imperial state.
